messages.subject: Programming with ggplot2
parts:
Hi all,

I've uploaded a draft of new chapter of the ggplot2 book at
http://rpubs.com/hadley/97970. It's all about programming with ggplot2
- I'd love your feedback.

Hadley

PS. I've been working intensely on the 2nd edition of the ggplot2 book
- it's going to be a big improvement! I've also been making quite a
few improvements in preparation for ggplot2 1.1.0. The release process
will probably start in a month or two, but you can try out the dev
version now: https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2. There's currently >50
improvements listed in
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/blob/master/NEWS.

--
http://had.co.nz/
